name: An avatar enters the world

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: The rite brings forth an avatar of Hakkar: a skeletal wind serpent, not the old god's later physical manifestation. The seeker's fight is with this summoned presence in the Sunken Temple. Blizzard's Burning Crusade manual distinguishes the temple's avatar from the later physical summoning in Zul'Gurub, a boundary that keeps this victory from becoming a claim that Hakkar himself was slain here.
